title: Hungary Opens Online Database of Communist-Era Informer Files
detail: On November 4 Hungary put a searchable online database of communist-era state security files online, announced by PM Péter Magyar. It includes a register of roughly 55,000 people in the informant network, with names and basic details; estimates of the number range from 50,000 to 60,000. Records of the III/I foreign intelligence branch are withheld on national security grounds, many files were destroyed in 1956 and in 1988-89, and informers' own reports are not published. A listing does not automatically mean someone was an agent. Further files are due by February 25, 2027.
